title: [Audit] Cross-space Kibana activity
description: Which identities operate in which Kibana spaces, across all Kibana traffic. Spaces are shown by id (the /s/<id> in the URL): the audit stream records no space display name. One row per identity: Spaces is how many distinct spaces they touched, listed alphabetically in Space list (wrapped to two lines; expand a row for the rest), and identities above 1 are the ones worth understanding. An Identity shown as “_4KEO… · Cloud API key” is an organization-level Elastic Cloud API key: the audit stream records it only by its opaque 20-character id, shown here by its first five characters; it has no name and no owner email.
esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE attributes.kibana.space.id IS NOT NULL | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | STATS events = COUNT(*), spaces = COUNT_DISTINCT(attributes.kibana.space.id), space_list = VALUES(attributes.kibana.space.id) BY actor | SORT spaces DESC, events DESC | EVAL space_list = REPLACE(MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(space_list), ", "), "-", "-⁠") | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor) | RENAME actor AS Identity, spaces AS Spaces, space_list AS `Space list`, events AS Events
